title: Suhba content
description: Definitions for every content file. Per-file schemas in this folder point at these.

id.description: ASCII slug: lowercase letters, digits, '-' and '.' between them.

citation.description: A pointer into one source. Never invent a locator: leave volume/page/hadithNumber out and set locatorStatus to 'pending' until checked against the edition.

coverage.description: The editor's statement of how complete the text is: 'skeleton' (headings or a profile only), 'sample' (a short pilot, not the full treatment) or 'complete' (written to the editorial brief). It is not an approval; the release checklist also checks coverage and review.

oneOf.description: A subheading inside a long passage. Not a claim.
Shows a visual (content/visuals/<id>.json) inside the passage. Its facts are sourced in the visual itself.

order.description: Display order in lists (lower first). Companions without one sort after those with one, by name.

complete.description: Every companion in the content has been checked against the category: anyone not a member is not one, except those in 'contested'.

contested.description: Companions whose membership the sources dispute.

geoPoint.description: A point for schematic maps. 'identified': the site is known today; 'approximate': the area is known; 'uncertain': scholars differ on where it was.

seerahFile.description: content/seerah/seerah.json: the Seerah section (محمد رسول الله ﷺ). The order of chapterIds is the reading order.

visualFile.description: content/visuals/<id>.json: an infographic. Every factual mark resolves to a record (event, place, companion timeline) or carries its own citations. 'takeaway' says in plain words what the reader should learn.

editionFile.description: content/release/edition.json: what the next public edition must contain. Word minimums diagnose thin drafts; they do not establish quality.
